audit.why: Both layers already read Skill / Skill / Trundle / Zaahen / Skill / Trundle / Zaahen, matching the packet chart, the mirror audit and a 51.8% win rate over 583 games. The whys[] text agrees with each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not a single cooldown on the page, and the two spikes that matter most are built on abilities whose timing is never given.
audit.why: Chomp is 3.5s — effectively always up, so it is not a window. Frozen Domain is 18s at rank 1, Pillar of Ice 21s, Subjugate 120s. Zaahen's Q and E are 10s at rank 1, W 14s, R 110s. Pillar of Ice at 21s is the longest gap in Trundle's kit and it is the only thing that stops Aureate Rush.
audit.corrected: Number Frozen Domain at 18s, Pillar of Ice at 21s and Subjugate at 120s, and make the dash timing key off the pillar rather than off Chomp.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate fabrications. (1) Subjugate is called 'true damage' twice — it steals a percent of Health, Armor and Magic Resist, and doubles the theft over 4 seconds; there is no true damage in it. (2) spikes[1] and mid claim Zaahen's ultimate 'steals his bruiser stats' — it does not; it damages and heals for a portion of the damage dealt. Trundle is the one who steals stats. (3) wants.foe[1] says Chomp shreds armor; it saps Attack Damage. (4) wants.you[2] describes 'Q's ranged pull-poke' — Zaahen's Q is an on-attack ability; the 850-range pull is his W. Zaahen's E and R are also named 'Golden Onslaught' and 'Final Retribution' rather than Aureate Rush and Grim Deliverance.
audit.why: Riot's text: Subjugate 'immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount... is doubled.' Chomp 'sapping some of their Attack Damage'. Zaahen's R 'damaging enemies and healing for a portion of the damage dealt'. The missing-interaction file adds two rules the page never mentions: Pillar of Ice denies Aureate Rush, and Frozen Domain plus King's Tribute make Grievous Wounds timing decisive.
audit.corrected: Replace the invented true damage and stat-steal with the real effects, put Pillar of Ice's 21s terrain on the dash advice, and make Grievous Wounds the stated answer to Frozen Domain's healing amplification.

edits.after: At 4-5 you pull ahead as The Darkin Glaive and Aureate Rush (E) let you punish him off his domain.

edits.after: On his first item Frozen Domain uptime and Subjugate's resist steal restore his edge in sustained duels.

edits.after: Two items in you reclaim the lane as the Glaive reset and Aureate Rush burst him before Subjugate lands.

edits.before: Trundle's spike is level 3 once he has Chomp (Q) plus Frozen Domain (W): standing in his W he out-DPSes and out-sustains you, and his Q shreds your AD and slows, so avoid extended trades on his ice patch and only commit when W is down.
edits.after: Trundle's spike is level 3 with Chomp (Q, 3.5s) and Frozen Domain (W, 18s): on his ice he out-DPSes and out-sustains you, and Chomp is an auto reset that saps your Attack Damage — the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Fight off the patch.

edits.before: Your R Final Retribution flips the duel back even — the healing and resist steal turns Trundle's own bruiser stats against him, so this is your best all-in window before Subjugate (his R) is a threat; bait his W then ult inside it.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the duel: Grim Deliverance (R, 110s) heals off the damage it deals, so it out-paces Frozen Domain if you carry Grievous Wounds. Bait Pillar of Ice first — 21s at rank 1, and the only thing in his kit that stops your dash.

edits.before: On his first item (usually Sunfire or Cleaver) Trundle's Frozen Domain uptime and true-damage % on R make him the stronger sustained duelist again if you fight on his terms.
edits.after: On his first item Trundle's Frozen Domain uptime and Subjugate's Health, Armor and Magic Resist theft make him the stronger sustained duelist if you fight on his terms.

edits.before: Two items in, your kite-and-poke pattern with Q Darkin Glaive resets and empowered E Golden Onslaught lets you burst him before Subjugate drains you; disengage the moment his W drops and re-engage on your terms.
edits.after: Two items in, the Glaive reset and Aureate Rush let you burst him before Subjugate finishes draining; hold your dash until Pillar of Ice is spent, because that pillar is impassable terrain and will strand you mid-commit.

edits.before: Level 3 is Trundle's window: with Chomp and Frozen Domain up he wins any fight on his ice, so back off. At 4-5 you edge ahead as your Q poke and E burst come online off-domain, then level 6 flips heavily your way — R Final Retribution steals his bruiser stats and out-heals his sustain in the all-in.
edits.after: Level 3 is Trundle's window: with Chomp and Frozen Domain up he wins any fight on his ice, so back off. At 4-5 you edge ahead as The Darkin Glaive and Aureate Rush come online off-domain, then 6 evens out — Grim Deliverance heals off its own damage, but Subjugate steals your resists straight back.

edits.before: On even items Trundle reclaims the sustained duel through Frozen Domain uptime and Subjugate's true-damage drain, so pick your fights off his W. By two-plus items your kite pattern and empowered E burst let you spike him down before his ult finishes draining you.
edits.after: On even items Trundle reclaims the sustained duel through Frozen Domain uptime and Subjugate's Health and resist theft, so pick your fights off his W. By two-plus items your pattern bursts him first — just hold Aureate Rush until Pillar of Ice (21s) is spent.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Burst before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, steals your Health, Armor and MR. - Pillar of Ice 21s is impassable terrain: it strands your dash. - Frozen Domain 18s boosts all his healing.

notes: Densest set of fabrications in the slice, and the packet flagged zero defects and zero suspectNames here — worth knowing that a clean packet is not evidence a page is correct, since the near-miss detector only catches names close to real ones. Killed: Subjugate as 'true damage' (it steals Health, Armor and MR, doubled over 4 seconds), Zaahen's R as a stat-stealer (it heals off its own damage — the page had attributed Trundle's own ultimate to Zaahen), Chomp as an armor shred (it saps Attack Damage), and 'Q's ranged pull-poke' (Q is an on-attack ability; the 850 pull is W). Chart was already correct.
